{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Arrays

|descr= Returns array of paths to all matching elements in deeply nested array, similar to [[BIS_fnc_findNestedElement]] but with all occurences.

|s1= [array, query] call [[BIS_fnc_findAllNestedElements]]

|p1= array: [[Array]] - array to explore

|p2= query: [[Anything]] - wanted item

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]] of [[Number]]s - path to the first occurence of ''query''

|x1= <sqf>
private _array = [[1, 2, 3], [[1, 2, 3], 1, 2, 3]];
_result = [_array, 2] call BIS_fnc_findAllNestedElements; // returns [[0, 1], [1, 0, 1], [1, 2]]
</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_findNestedElement]] [[BIS_fnc_removeNestedElement]] [[BIS_fnc_returnNestedElement]] [[BIS_fnc_setNestedElement]]
}}
